headline: FDA GRAS rule fight & NY GRAS bill; Barry Callebaut chocolate trends; lab-grown cocoa in Medford
summary: GRAS is under pressure on two fronts: industry groups want more time to comment on FDA's proposed GRAS rule and a New York GRAS bill is heading to the governor, so Puratos regulatory should review self-affirmed GRAS ingredients and feed into trade-association comments.

Washington is again eyeing a federal ultra-processed foods definition, which could reach bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers using improvers and emulsifiers; keep clean-label alternatives ready.

Barry Callebaut is publicly setting the agenda on next-wave chocolate innovation, while cocoa supply has recovered but stays volatile; Belcolade should benchmark its roadmap and keep hedging cocoa risk.
A lab-grown chocolate producer is setting up in Medford, another sign that cocoa alternatives are scaling in the US and worth adding to the scouting pipeline.
For Bakery, par-baked bread shelf-life research, plant-protein formulation for high-protein claims and upcycled coffee grounds in cookies offer concrete product ideas.

items.title: Barry Callebaut spotlights emerging trends driving the next wave of chocolate innovation
items.summary: Barry Callebaut outlines the emerging trends it sees driving the next wave of chocolate innovation.
items.why: Direct competitor signalling on chocolate innovation priorities; Belcolade should benchmark its roadmap against it.

items.title: Cocoa complications: Senior leaders warn of complex challenges ahead
items.summary: Industry leaders say cocoa supply has recovered from the deficit but climate, disease and weak demand keep the market volatile.
items.why: Cocoa price and supply volatility remains a planning risk for Belcolade sourcing and customer pricing.

items.title: Partially baked bread: a promising approach to extend the shelf life—a review
items.summary: Review from CSIR-CFTRI on partially baked (par-baked) bread as a way to extend shelf life.
items.why: Par-baked bread is core to Puratos' industrial and in-store bakery customers; a reference for improver and shelf-life solutions.

items.title: Lab-grown chocolate, insect kibble get a Medford home
items.summary: News that a lab-grown chocolate producer (alongside insect pet-food maker) is setting up in Medford.
items.why: Cell-cultured cocoa scaling in the US is a cocoa-alternative signal for Belcolade; identify the company as a scouting target.

items.title: Sophisticated solutions: suppliers unveil new bakery ingredients
items.summary: British Baker round-up of new bakery ingredients unveiled by suppliers.
items.why: Competitor launch tracking for Bakery and Patisserie; check which suppliers and claims are featured.

items.title: Formulation strategies for plant-based protein
items.summary: Baking Business piece on formulation strategies for adding plant proteins to bakery and snacks for high-protein claims.
items.why: High-protein bakery is a growing customer ask; Puratos can position protein-enriched mixes and improvers that fix volume and texture losses.

items.title: Vegan Baking Ingredients Market Forecast to 2035: Industrial Bakery Reformulation Drives Growth - News and Statistics
items.summary: IndexBox market forecast to 2035 for vegan baking ingredients, citing industrial bakery reformulation as the growth driver.
items.why: Supports demand for Puratos egg/dairy-replacement solutions in industrial bakery; useful for market sizing.

items.title: Espresso Spent Coﬀee Grounds as a Dough-Restructuring Agent in Composite Short Doughs: Workability, Shape Stability and Baking Performance of Cookies
items.summary: Study replacing up to 20% of wheat flour in cookie short doughs with dried espresso spent coffee grounds, measuring rheology, shape stability and baking performance; cookies kept their spread within 3.3% of control.
items.why: Upcycled coffee grounds as a functional flour replacer in biscuits and short pastry is a sustainability/fibre ingredient idea for Bakery and Patisserie R&D.

items.title: Washington on watch again for ultra-processed foods definition
items.summary: Washington is again watching for a federal definition of ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A UPF definition could hit bakery, patisserie and confectionery customers using emulsifiers, improvers and additives; monitor and prepare clean-label alternatives.

items.title: November 2026: Top Bakery Trends report
items.summary: British Baker's November 2026 report on top bakery trends.
items.why: Trend input for Bakery and Patisserie marketing and innovation pipelines.

items.title: Industry groups request more time to comment on GRAS rule
items.summary: Industry groups asked FDA for more time to comment on its proposed GRAS rule.
items.why: The GRAS rule could change how new ingredients (enzymes, cultures, fibres) reach the US market; Puratos regulatory should track the comment deadline and join trade association input.

items.title: State Legislation Update: New York GRAS Bill Heads to Governor While 2027 Prefiling Begins
items.summary: A New York state GRAS bill is heading to the governor as 2027 state prefiling begins.
items.why: State-level GRAS disclosure laws could force reformulation or notification for ingredients sold to New York customers; review the ingredient portfolio for self-affirmed GRAS items.

items.title: Why Food Makers Are Rebuilding Their Recipes Around Metabolic Health
items.summary: Article on food makers reformulating recipes around metabolic health.
items.why: Metabolic-health reformulation (fibre, lower sugar, GI) is an opportunity for Puratos health-oriented bakery and filling solutions.

items.title: Scientists Review Evolving Evidence Behind Regulatory Bans on Common Food Additives
items.summary: Scientists review the evolving evidence behind regulatory bans on common food additives.
items.why: Additive bans (dyes, emulsifiers, preservatives) drive reformulation across all three units; useful for anticipating the next targets.
